title: One typed fluid viewport, no width breakpoints

costar.context: The maintainer rejected hardcoded theme values and width breakpoints. The viewport has to be a fluid clamp system, with the tools installed, and images sized from those tokens.
costar.objective: Make ui/src/lib/token the only place that names the viewport, the type scale, the space scale, and the image sizes. Utopia calculates the clamps. Screens consume the variables.
costar.style: One typed viewport module, generated custom properties, and layout that wraps without a width query.
costar.audience: The maintainer and the next coding agent.
costar.response: utopia-core owns the math. The viewport is 320 to 1240. Type, space, and image sizes are clamp tokens. Width breakpoints come out. Color is declared once with light-dark().

concerns: A type step that fails WCAG 1.4.4 at 200% zoom cannot ship. calculateTypeScale reports that as wcagViolation.
Space in px would ignore browser text zoom. The clamps stay in rem.
prefers-color-scheme, prefers-reduced-motion, and prefers-contrast are user preferences. Removing them would break the theme and the motion cut.
light-dark() follows color-scheme. An explicit data-theme has to set color-scheme or the forced theme is ignored.
Image files are not resized in this pass. The layout only reserves the fluid slot.
context: Style tokens already live in ui/src/lib/token. The cyber palette was copied into three CSS blocks, and the screens stack with max-width queries at 900px and 700px.
current_state: color.css repeats the palette for :root, .dark, and the dark color-scheme query. --space-1 through --space-4 are fixed rem. Six route splits and the mailbox use a width media query. utopia-core is not installed. No image size token exists.
target_design: viewport.ts is the typed range, 320 to 1240. utopia-core calculates the type scale, the space scale, and the image clamps. A Vite plugin serves those custom properties. --space-1 through --space-4 alias the fluid steps. Columns use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, var(--measure)), 1fr)). Each color is one light-dark() value. Images use max-inline-size: 100% and the --img-* clamps.
changes: Add utopia-core and record the viewport in ui/src/lib/token/viewport.ts.
Generate --step-*, --space-*, and --img-* clamps from that module. Fail the build if a type step reports wcagViolation.
Point the existing space aliases and the heading sizes at those tokens.
Declare each color once with light-dark(). Set color-scheme from data-theme.
Remove the width media queries. Let the grid wrap on the fluid measure.
Reserve image slots with the fluid clamps. Do not export or recompress image files in this pass.
boundaries: Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono stay.
Do not add a width breakpoint.
Do not resize or recompress the portal font or image files in this pass.
The portal screen conversion stays on 2026-11-04-portal-to-svelte and stays draft.

verification.name: no-width-breakpoints-and-fluid-clamps
verification.command: python -c "from pathlib import Path; root=Path('ui/src'); texts=[p.read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in root.rglob('*') if p.suffix in {'.css','.svelte','.ts'}]; blob='\n'.join(texts); assert 'max-width:' not in blob, 'width breakpoint remains'; assert 'clamp(' in blob or 'virtual:shippin-fluid' in blob; assert 'light-dark(' in blob; assert '#39ff14' in blob; print('ok')"
verification.proves: Screens and tokens have no width breakpoint, color is a light-dark token, the neon primary remains, and the fluid clamp source is present. A leftover 900px query fails this.

verification.proves: The plan matches the plans schema and the other modules still match theirs.
